title: The caption words walk reaches the Captions panel again
goal: A walk that checks how caption words pop has stopped working: the talking recording now opens to watch, with the editing panel shut, so the walk never reaches the caption controls it is meant to check. It should switch to editing first, like the other caption walks.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-29 on main before and after the dropdown change: `Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/caption-words-pop-walk.json --no-build` -> `[10 reveal] FAILED: no control called "Caption style Caption" is in the panel; the ones that are: Volume (Transport) ... View Mode (the title bar's switch, on), Edit Mode (the title bar's switch), Panel (the title bar's panel toggle, panel closed)`. Cause: view-mode-and-edit-mode-a-recording-opens-to-wat (done) makes a recording open in View mode. Fix: add {"do":"press","control":"Edit Mode"} after the tool step, as every-dropdown-opens-on-a-click-walk does. Other walks that open a talk and expect the panel may need the same; `queue/bin/sweep.sh status` will list them.
acceptance: caption-words-pop-walk switches to Edit and reaches the Caption style tiles at Next defaults
The walk passes end to end, or any step that still fails is filed as its own app bug

log.note: Heads up from every-caption-style-control-changes-the-captions (2026-09-29): its Current word glow step is now a colour well (press Color in "Word glow", press Shades 3, escape) since the named-colour menus are gone. The walk still fails at step 10 because the recording opens in View mode with the panel closed; add a press on Edit Mode before selectRow, as every-caption-control-changes-the-captions-walk does.
triage 2026-09-29: retagged design-system -> video-audio: the walk checks captions, which the video-audio epic owns; design-system is staged next, and this serves the focus

Reproduced: step 10 reveal failed, panel closed in View mode. Added press Edit Mode + 0.8s wait after the tool step. Walk now ok, 47 steps, 7 real captures (4-past-its-size-on-the-bounce-sc.png shows one word with a gold glow, Show = 1 word). Checked the other walks that open the talk without an Edit press: a-title-reads-over-a-video, a-video-edit-saves-as-a-project, captions-are-one-layer, captions-on-demand, captions-guides-and-track-bar, captions-panel-keeps-its-margins all pass; panel-rows-read-as-one-column fails on a duplicate 'Kind' (Shadow 1/Shadow 2), already owned by the-panel-rows-walk-finds-the-title-shadow-it-me. No audit: walk-only fix, no feature changed. Scripts/test.sh green (10570 tests).
